headline: Apple sues OpenAI over alleged use of copyrighted data for AI training
summary: The tech giant claims OpenAI used its data without permission, potentially impacting the AI firm's IPO plans.
details: Apple has filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging that the AI company used copyrighted material from its users to train its large language models.
The lawsuit, which is described as 'readable and intense,' raises questions about the methods used by AI companies to acquire training data.
While some experts suggest these practices are common in the industry, Apple's public legal battle could have significant implications for OpenAI's upcoming IPO.
This move by Apple might be seen as a strategic play to either disrupt a competitor or capitalize on a perceived weakness in OpenAI's operations.
The legal action comes as Apple rolls out its own AI-enhanced software, including a new version of Siri, which is currently in public beta.
The outcome of this lawsuit could set a precedent for how AI models are trained and how intellectual property is protected in the rapidly evolving AI landscape.

headline_marked: Apple Music [[price hike]] hits US, UK, and Europe
headline: Apple Music price hike hits US, UK, and Europe
summary: Individual plans now cost $11.99/month in the US, with family and student plans also seeing increases. Apple cites rising licensing costs.
details: Apple Music's individual plan has increased to $11.99 per month in the US, a $1 bump from the previous $10.99. Family plans are now $19.99 (up from $16.99), and student plans are $6.99 (up from $5.99).
Apple stated that the price increases are a direct result of rising licensing costs. This marks the first price hike for Apple Music in years.
The price increases are also affecting users in the UK and Europe, with reports indicating that other countries may also see similar adjustments.
This follows a trend of price hikes across Apple's services, including Apple TV Plus and Apple One, which also saw increases in October 2022.
Apple has also reportedly raised prices for AppleCare Plus subscriptions for Macs and iPads. Meanwhile, Spotify recently increased its Premium plan in the US from $11.99 to $12.99 per month.
